name: CookFrom
summary: Cook with what you already have. Choose or photograph your ingredients and get an AI-assisted recipe you can adjust, save, and cook from step by step.
supportSummary: Troubleshooting for AI recipe generation, ingredient photo recognition, Pro entitlement and purchase restoration, and application data.
visualNote: Screens captured from the CookFrom closed-testing Android beta (0.11.78) on a fresh emulator with no user data. The recipe shown is a built-in catalogue recipe, not a freshly generated AI response.
